'''''Limbarda''''' is a [[genus]] of [[succulent]], [[xerophytic]]  plants in the [[Asteraceae|daisy family]].<ref>[https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/page/3611093#page/671/mode/1up Adanson, Michel. 1763.  Familles des Plantes 2: 125, 570] in French</ref><ref>[http://www.tropicos.org/Name/40006808 Tropicos, Limbarda Adans.]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/floraspecie.php?genere=Limbarda Altervista Flora Italiana, genere ''Limbarda''] includes photos and distribution maps</ref>

; Species<ref name=z>[http://dixon.iplantcollaborative.org/CompositaeWeb/Default.aspx?Page=NameSearch&searchText=Limbarda&searchField=NameFull Flann, C (ed) 2009+ Global Compositae Checklist ] {{webarchive|url=https://archive.today/20141217143350/http://dixon.iplantcollaborative.org/CompositaeWeb/Default.aspx?Page=NameSearch&searchText=Limbarda&searchField=NameFull |date=2014-12-17 }}</ref>
* ''[[Limbarda crithmoides]]'' <small>(L.) Dumort.</small> - (golden samphire) - [[Mediterranean Region]] and [[British Isles]]
* ''[[Limbarda salsoloides]]''  <small>(Turcz.) Ikonn.</small> - [[Mongolia]]

; formerly included<ref name=z/>
''Limbarda japonica'' <small>(Thunb.) Raf.</small> - ''[[Inula japonica]]'' <small>Thunb.</small>
